newsitem.title: USA: Twin Disc backlog up 10 pct at end of Q2.
newsitem.headline: Twin Disc backlog up 10 pct at end of Q2.

text.p: Twin Disc Inc said its backlog of new orders to be shipped in the next six months rose to $75 million at the end of its December 31 second quarter, up 10 percent from the same year-earlier period.

"Demand generally remains stable," said chairman Michael Batten in a statement. "Backlog increases during the quarter were provided by the higher shipments scheduled for (the company's) Tatra (truck contract) beginning in June and by recent orders for several specialty transmission systems."
Batten said second-half shipping levels are expected to be similar to a year ago.
Twin Disc manufactures industrial power and transmission equipment.
